reading.completion_decay: any measured higher-fold completion rate below the measured one-fold rate
reading.fold_count_limit: recommend the highest powered fold count whose completion matches the one-fold control
reading.paired_uncertainty: pair every higher-fold case against the same task's one-fold control outcome and report the interval at each measured fold count
reading.evidence_floor: a measured fold group below minimum_paired_cases_per_fold is reported but never cuts the fold-count verdict
reading.guard_fit: resolve the fitted cell's guard per family from that family's own measured fold length AND its own measured per-step transcript growth, so the rung held equal across families is the measured fold count and not one shared char guard
reading.fold_span_calibration: replay the fold length at the span the fitted cell's own folds offer, interpolated from the two never-fitted cells' measured (offered span, written length) points, and refuse to invent a slope when only one span was measured
reading.fit_calibration: state the fitted guard's predicted case count beside the count the family then measured, and name the family and guard of every divergence rather than reporting the fit as a pass
reading.ladder_coverage: state whether every measured fold group on every qualified family reaches the evidence floor, and name the family, fold count and guard of each one that does not
reading.replication: extend the fold-count rule only through a fold count every qualified family reaches powered, or name the first family and fold that fails
reading.mechanism: pair typed-marker preservation against a model-summary-only ablation on every identical case
